name: webcon-mcp-assistant
description: Read-only assistant skill for the General WEBCON MCP server (tasks, elements, search, navigation).

mcp_url.title: WEBCON MCP server URL
mcp_url.description: MCP endpoint of your WEBCON server (the /docs link with /docs stripped), e.g. https://mcp.webconbps.com/api/mcp/server/1

mcp_client_id.title: WEBCON OAuth client ID
mcp_client_id.description: Client ID of the OAuth client (API Key) your WEBCON admin pre-registered for this MCP server (Authorization Code + PKCE).

mcp_client_secret.title: WEBCON OAuth client secret
mcp_client_secret.description: Client secret issued when the OAuth client was registered in WEBCON. Stored in the OS keychain, never committed.

mcp_scopes.title: WEBCON OAuth scopes
mcp_scopes.description: Exact space-separated scopes registered for this client (from the server /docs page or /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource), e.g. Mcp.Tools User.Elements.Read.All openid profile email
